name: gizza-ai/gost-magma-cipher
summary: Encrypt or decrypt text with the GOST Magma cipher (ECB/CBC).

tool.description: Encrypt or decrypt text with the GOST 28147-89 / GOST R 34.12-2015 'Magma' 64-bit block cipher (RFC 8891) using a raw key you provide. cipher = cbc (default) or ecb. The key is a fixed 256-bit (32-byte) value; cbc needs an 8-byte iv, ecb none. key, iv and ciphertext are hex or base64 (set format; default base64); the plaintext is UTF-8. Both modes use PKCS7 padding. This is a low-level tool — for passphrase encryption with a safe random salt+nonce use text-encrypt instead.

data.description: For encrypt: the plaintext. For decrypt: the ciphertext, encoded with `format`.

cipher.description: Mode of operation: cbc (default) or ecb (insecure — reveals patterns; avoid).

iv.description: The 8-byte IV, encoded with `format`. Required for cbc; omit for ecb.

format.description: Encoding for the key, iv, and ciphertext (base64 default, or hex). The plaintext is always UTF-8 text.
